_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the picker" is the skill picker [data-testid="skill-picker"]; its options are its [role="option"] elements; "the chip" is [data-testid="skill-chip"]. On a wide screen, hovering long MCP tool details keeps the picker's height and position fixed. The page's one MCP server, web, has the tool "search" with a very long description ("Long MCP tool description. " repeated). window.pickerBox() returns the picker's bounding box as JSON. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/skills. 2. Fill the input with "/skills " (with the trailing space). 3. Exactly one option should contain "search". 4. Hover the option containing "draft-review". 5. Eval window.pickerBox(); its height must be exactly 420: eval JSON.parse(window.pickerBox()).height with expect "420". 6. Save the box: eval window.savedBox = window.pickerBox(). 7. Hover the option containing "search". 8. The picker's ".skill-picker-detail" should contain "Long MCP tool description.". 9. The box is unchanged: eval window.pickerBox() === window.savedBox with expect "true". 10. The detail overflows and scrolls: eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="skill-picker"] .skill-picker-detail'); return el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight; })() with expect "true". 11. Hover the option containing "draft-review" again. 12. The box is still unchanged: eval window.pickerBox() === window.savedBox with expect "true".
